senses.gloss:
I. कुञ्च् कुञ्च्, i. 1, and कुच् कुच्, [] i. 6, Par.
 1. To straiten, to make narrow, Ṛt. 4, 16.
 2. To bend, Rām. 5, 55, 27; Pañc. 50, 10.
 3. To crisp, MBh. 1, 2170.
 II. † कुच् कुच्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To sound high.
 2. To go.
 3. To polish.
 4. To be crooked.
 5. To draw furrows.
 6. To resist.
 --With the prepos. आ आ, आकुञ्चित,
 1. Compressed, Rām. 3, 31, 21.
 2. Contracted, Bhartṛ. 1, 3.
 3. Crisped, MBh. 13, 882.
 --With वि वि, विकुञ्चित,
 1. Frowning, MBh. 1, 4112.
 2. Crisped, Ṛt. 3, 19.
 --Caus. कुञ्चय, To turn backwards (?), Rām. 5, 5, 18.
 --With सम् सम्, कुच्.
 1. To contract one's self, Pañc. 3, 40.
 2. To close, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 3.
 संकुचित,
 1. Contracted, Bhartṛ. 3, 74.
 2. Shut, Rām. 4, 30, 20.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. कोचय,
 1. To contract, MBh. 1, 2843.
 2. To diminish, Bhartṛ. 2, 37.
 --Cf. Lat. quic in conquinisco, conquexi, cûlus for cuc + lus; κύκλος; Goth. hauh; N.H.G. hucke in huckeback, etc.
कुञ्चन कुञ्च् + अन, n. Shrinking, Suśr. 1, 251, 16.
कुञ्चिका कुञ्चिका, i. e. कुञ्च् + अक, f. A key, Bhartṛ. 1, 62.

† कुञ्ज् कुञ्ज्, i. 1, Par. To make any inarticulate sound.
 --Cf. कूज्.

कुञ्ज कुञ्ज, m.
 1. A place overgrown with creeping plants, a bower, Megh. 19.
 2. A cavern, Rām. 4, 26, 6; Ragh. 9, 64.

कुञ्जर कुञ्जर (probably akin to the preceding), m.
 1. An elephant, Pañc. i. d. 177.
 2. Preeminent, Rām. 5, 2, 13; in this meaning it is generally the latter part of a compound, e. g. कपि-, m. A most excellent monkey [] (literally, an elephant among monkeys), Rām. 5, 3, 17.
 3. The name of a Nāga, or serpent, MBh. 1, 1560.
 4. The name of a prince, 3, 15597.
 5. The name of a mountain, Rām. 4, 41, 50.
कुञ्जर- + ग्रह कुञ्जर- + ग्रह, m. a hunter of elephants, Rām. 2, 91, 55.
कुञ्जर- + रूपिन् कुञ्जर- + रूपिन्, adj. having the shape of an elephant, Sund. 2, 20.
